site.name: Cyber Pulse Academy
site.description: Free, accessible, non-commercial cyber security study platform. Realistic hands-on scenario exercises for SOC analysts, incident responders, threat hunters, GRC analysts, pentesters, cloud engineers and students.
search.label: Search the catalog
search.noResultsHint: Try a shorter term, an ATT&CK identifier such as T1059, or browse a catalog instead.
filter.none: No topics match the current filters.
batch.heading: Exercises
batch.intro: Each exercise is a separate activity. Some are lessons, some are quizzes, and some are hands-on scenarios. Open any that is ready.

batch.timeout.title: The exercise is taking too long
batch.timeout.body: It did not finish loading in time. Your connection may be slow, or the file may be unavailable right now.

coverage.lede: Every topic on the site, and how many of its exercises are ready to open. Topics with fewer exercises are the ones still being written.

share.templateNoScore: {title} on Cyber Pulse Academy: {exercises} exercises from easy to extremely hard. Free, no paywall, no adverts.

support.title: Support Cyber Pulse Academy
support.thanksBody: Your support pays for the time that goes into writing new exercises and keeping this site free.
support.disclaimer: Voluntary personal support. Not a purchase. Not tax-deductible.
support.processedBy: Donations are processed by PayPal. Cyber Pulse Academy never sees or stores your card details.

consent.title: A note on storage
consent.body: Cyber Pulse Academy stores your theme choice and your exercise scores in this browser only, and asks you for nothing: no name, no country, no account. There are no advertising or tracking cookies.
storage.warning: This browser is blocking local storage, so progress cannot be saved between visits. Everything still works for this session.
theme.toggle: Switch between dark and light theme
error.generic.title: Something went wrong
error.generic.body: The page could not finish loading its data. You can retry, or browse a catalog directly.
error.catalog.title: The catalog could not be loaded
error.catalog.body: data/catalog.json did not load. If you opened this file directly from disk, serve the folder over HTTP instead: python -m http.server 8000
notfound.title: Page not found
notfound.body: That address does not exist on Cyber Pulse Academy. It may have been renamed, or the link may be mistyped.
home.stats.coverageNote: Covered means at least one exercise is ready to start. Everything else is documented and still waiting for its exercises.

donate.thanks: Thank you. Your support keeps this site free for everyone.

home.request.title: Ask for a topic
home.request.lede: {waiting} topics are already documented and waiting for their exercises. Requests decide what gets written first, so tell us which one you want next.
home.request.note: Posting a request needs a GitHub account; this site has no signup of its own. Asking buys no priority and no extra content - it only tells us what to write first.
